backend.checkLogsAt: Check the logs in {{path}} and contact us.
backend.checkLogs: Check the backend logs and contact us.

portInUse.title: Port already in use
portInUse.detail: Another process is using the port Erudi needs for its local server.
portInUse.hint: Quit any other running Erudi (or the app holding the port) and relaunch.

noPortAvailable.title: No free port
noPortAvailable.detail: Erudi could not find a free port to start its local server.
noPortAvailable.hint: Close other apps using local ports, then relaunch Erudi.

portTimeout.title: Backend did not start in time
portTimeout.detail: The local server did not come up within the startup window.
portTimeout.hint: Relaunch Erudi. If it keeps happening, check the backend log.

crashBeforeReady.title: Backend crashed on startup
crashBeforeReady.detail: The local server stopped before it became ready.
crashBeforeReady.hint: Relaunch Erudi; if it persists, check the backend log.

importError.title: Backend failed to load
importError.detail: A required backend component could not be loaded.
importError.hint: Reinstall or update Erudi, then check the backend log.

dataPrepError.title: Could not prepare app data
dataPrepError.detail: Erudi could not set up its data directory.
dataPrepError.hint: Check available disk space and permissions, then relaunch.

databaseError.title: Database error
databaseError.detail: Erudi's local database failed to start.
databaseError.hint: Relaunch Erudi; if it persists, check the backend log.

cudaRuntimeError.title: GPU runtime error
cudaRuntimeError.detail: The CUDA runtime failed to initialize.
cudaRuntimeError.hint: Update your NVIDIA driver, or use the CPU build of Erudi.

missingDependency.title: Missing system dependency
missingDependency.detail: A system library Erudi needs is missing.
missingDependency.hint: Reinstall Erudi, then check the backend log.

backendNotFound.title: Backend not found
backendNotFound.detail: The bundled backend executable could not be located.

backendStartupFailed.title: Backend failed to start
backendStartupFailed.detail: The local server could not start after several attempts.
backendStartupFailed.hint: Relaunch Erudi; if it persists, check the backend log.

backendExitError.title: Backend stopped unexpectedly
backendExitError.detail: The local server process exited with an error.
backendExitError.hint: Relaunch Erudi; if it persists, check the backend log.

backendSpawnFailed.title: Backend could not be launched
backendSpawnFailed.detail: Erudi could not start its local server process.
backendSpawnFailed.hint: Reinstall Erudi (or allow it through antivirus/SmartScreen), then relaunch.

unexpectedError.title: Unexpected startup error
unexpectedError.detail: Something went wrong while starting Erudi.
unexpectedError.hint: Relaunch Erudi, then check the backend log.

pollingError.title: Lost track of the backend
pollingError.detail: Erudi stopped monitoring the backend during startup.

backendUnreachable.title: Can't reach the backend
backendUnreachable.hint: Relaunch Erudi; if it persists, check the backend log.

unknown.title: Backend failed to start
unknown.hint: Relaunch Erudi; if it persists, check the backend log.

unreachable.label: Backend unreachable
unreachable.title: The local backend is not responding
unreachable.tooltip: The local backend stopped responding. Restart it to reconnect.

recovering.label: Restoring the database...
recovering.title: The local database is recovering
recovering.tooltip: The local database is restoring. Your data is safe; this clears on its own.

databaseError.label: Database error
databaseError.title: The local database hit an error
databaseError.tooltip: The local database hit an error. Restart the backend to recover.

offline.label: Offline
offline.title: No network connection
offline.tooltip: No network: the catalog and downloads are unavailable, but chatting with installed models still works.

connected.label: Connected
connected.title: Connected to a network
connected.tooltip: You can chat with installed models offline. Installing new ones needs a connection.

computeCapabilityTooLow.title: This graphics card is too old for GPU mode
computeCapabilityTooLow.detail: This computer's NVIDIA graphics card is older than the oldest one Erudi's GPU mode supports, so it cannot run models on the GPU.
computeCapabilityTooLow.detailWithCapability: {{gpu}} is a compute capability {{capability}} card. Erudi's GPU mode needs 5.0 or newer, and no driver update changes that.
computeCapabilityTooLow.hint: Run Erudi on the processor instead. It is slower, but every feature works.

driverTooOld.title: The NVIDIA driver is too old for GPU mode
driverTooOld.detail: Erudi's GPU mode needs a newer NVIDIA driver than the one installed on this computer.
driverTooOld.detailWithVersions: {{gpu}} needs an NVIDIA driver that provides CUDA {{required}} or newer. This computer reports CUDA {{driver}}.
driverTooOld.hint: Updating the NVIDIA driver is the fix. Running on the processor is the workaround until you do.

outOfMemory.title: The graphics card ran out of memory
outOfMemory.detail: There is not enough free video memory to load this model on the GPU.
outOfMemory.hint: Choose a smaller model, close the other applications using the graphics card, or run Erudi on the processor.

cudaError.title: GPU mode stopped working
cudaError.detail: Erudi's GPU mode stopped before it could answer. The technical details below say what the graphics driver reported.
cudaError.hint: Report the problem so it can be fixed, and run Erudi on the processor in the meantime.

modal.reportIntro: Telling us about it helps. Include the technical details above.
modal.switchNote: Erudi restarts its engine to apply this. You can switch back in Settings at any time.
modal.switchFailed: The switch did not go through. Try again, or change it in Settings.
modal.cpuInstallerNote: Reinstalling with the processor version of Erudi also avoids the GPU entirely.
